style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Tuala Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: This Tuala baubles are designed with a classic, decorative shape that brings subtle texture along with character to festive decorating. Their faceted form is Drawing influence from cut gemstones, combining crisp angles with a softened finish. A distressed silver surface adds a vintage feel, making them a versatile addition to both traditional and contemporary settings. Whether hung on a tree or styled around the home, they offer a classic decorative detail with a handmade edges. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade.
